Core types shared by the library, the linters, and the config file.

The types a linter author needs are re-exported by lint. The rest are internal to the runner and the config macro.

Types

Check[S] = object
  name*: string
  run*: proc (ast: PNode; settings: S): seq[Finding]
  defaults*: S               ## Used when a config declares the check without settings.
One check declared by a linter, bound to its settings type. Source   Edit   
Config = object
  sources*: seq[string]
  ignoredPatterns*: seq[string]
  steps*: seq[Step]
Source   Edit   
Finding = object
  line*: int
  col*: int
  msg*: string
What a check returns. Deliberately carries no severity, no label, and no file path: the runner stamps those. Source   Edit   
Linter = object
  name*: string
A group of checks. A linter module exports one Linter value. Source   Edit   
Severity = enum
  hint, error
Source   Edit   
Step = object
  label*: string
  linter*: string
  ignoredPatterns*: seq[string]
  checks*: seq[StepSetting]
One declared step block. Source   Edit   
StepSetting = object
  name*: string
  severity*: Severity
  run*: proc (ast: PNode): seq[Finding]
Runtime form of one check entry: the check plus its settings, type-erased at the last moment. Source   Edit

Used by linter modules to declare one check, its settings type, and the settings to use when a config does not provide any. Source   Edit
